neighbours.label: ' having', ' being' or ' regards' right after 'as' ('cited as having', 'described as being', 'as regards'); the same words without 'as' stay quiet.
fire: The paper was cited as having shown the effect.
The tune is described as being in a minor key.
Little was said as regards food and lodging.
He is remembered as having founded the school.
The car was listed as being in good order.
The rules are strict as regards safety.
She was praised as having saved the firm.
The item was flagged as being out of stock.
quiet: The paper was cited in a review of the effect.
The tune is written in a minor key.
Little was said about food and lodging.
He founded the school and remembered the date.
Being in good order, the car was listed.
Give my regards to the safety officer.
Having saved the firm, she was praised.
He is having soup and being quiet.

notes: Probes: 0.73-0.84 after 'as', under 0.07 elsewhere; 'as coming' 0.16. Remarkable for layer 0: the pole already depends on the previous token.
